name: SBI Life Insurance Company Ltd
title: SBI Life Insurance Company Ltd - 540719 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Life insurer with VoNB margin 27.5% (GST-hit; 29% ex-GST) and guided 26–28% range for FY27, growth held near 14%; no capacity or pricing-discipline signal, opex ratio rose to 6.1% from 5.3%.

triggers.label: Deferred annuity launch by June
triggers.quote: we are aiming to go live by June, we should launch the deferred annuity

triggers.label: VoNB margin 26–28% range held for FY27
triggers.quote: we expect that our margin will continue to be a similar range that we maintain about 26% to 28% range

triggers.label: Individual APE growth 13%, 3-yr CAGR 12.9%
triggers.quote: It grew by 12.9%, 3 -year CAGR, outperforming the industry average o f 8.5%

triggers.label: Opex ratio 5.3% → 6.1% on GST and labour code
triggers.quote: Excluding this impact, profit after tax for the year ended 31st March 2026 would have stood at INR31.2 billion

guidance.quote: we intend to maintain the growth rate at around 14%, which has been our CAGR for the last 3 to 5 years
we expect that our margin will continue to be a similar range that we maintain about 26% to 28% range
we are aiming to go live by June, we should launch the deferred annuity

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are happy that we have been able to meet more or less our annual guidance of 13%
we have been able to report VoNB margin at the higher end of the range of 26% to 28%

red_flags.label: Opex ratio up to 6.1% from 5.3%
red_flags.quote: the impact on cost in this particular year, last financial year is substantially coming from the GST impact
